children: JEFFERIES SEES EARNINGS PUSHING S&P 500 TO 8,000 BY YEAR-END
Jefferies equity strategist Jane Gibbons launched her S&P 500
outlook earlier this week with a forecast for the benchmark to reach 8,000 by year-end 2026 based on an expectation for 35% earnings per share growth.
From Tuesday's close that would imply a roughly 5.5% gain.
Gibbons also set a 9,000 year-end 2027 target for the index, based on 21% EPS growth, which would be more than two times the historical average.

"Our bullish outlook on equities is driven by the powerful earnings story, which we believe is still underappreciated by the Street and will be crystallized by upward revisions," Gibbons said in a research note.
While oil prices, inflation and rising 10-year yields "may compress multiples, it should not offset the impressive earnings story," she added.
